evidence.claim: Pytest caches one instance of a fixture per scope, so a fixture may be invoked more than once in a given scope when parametrized.
evidence.quote: Pytest only caches one instance of a fixture at a time, which means that when using a parametrized fixture, pytest may invoke a fixture more than once in the given scope.

evidence.claim: Using a larger scope such as module or session can reduce setup cost for expensive fixtures like Docker containers.
evidence.quote: In some cases, you might want to change the scope of the fixture without changing the code. This can be especially useful when dealing with fixtures that need time for setup, like spawning a docker container.
